6284.title: Native Claude installs are missed outside PATH
6284.rootCauseOneLine: POSIX provider maintenance searches PATH only, unlike the existing session resolver, so a native installation outside PATH remains missing after installation.
6284.proposedFix: Reuse the guarded existing POSIX session executable resolver after explicit overrides and PATH lookup; preserve Windows behavior.
6284.caveats: Two real maintenance-probe runs with an authored executable; no upstream installer, packaged upgrade, GUI restart, or macOS run. A local candidate passes its focused regression, but no PR is safe: five existing bridge-suite failures also occur on unchanged trusted main under root.
